refused: This is the translated preview — typing, adding and deleting happen in the base-language view; translate from the Translation tab. Dragging still works.

layout.heading: Element positions
layout.hint: Drag any text in the preview to move it. Offsets are relative, so they hold on every screen.
layout.resetDone: Positions are back to the original

i18n.intro: Write the {{lang}} version of each {{base}} text. Anything you leave empty keeps showing in the invitation's base language. The language button stays hidden from guests until you write at least one line.
i18n.counterNone: Nothing translated yet — the language button is hidden from guests.
i18n.empty: There are no texts in the invitation to translate.
i18n.cleared: The {{lang}} version was cleared — Ctrl+Z to undo
i18n.gear: Font and size of the translated text — the original is unaffected
i18n.styleFontHelp: Leave empty to use the invitation's font.
i18n.styleSizeHelp: Zero = same size as the original text.

element.title: Selected element
element.hint: Click anything inside the imported section — a word, an image, a button — to select it. Double-click text to type.
element.parentHint: Select the element that contains this one
element.keys: Click = select · double-click = type · Esc leaves typing · Delete removes · Ctrl+C copy · Ctrl+V paste · Ctrl+D duplicate · arrows nudge (Shift = bigger step) · Shift while dragging = fine move
element.newText: New text — double-click it and type

fail.missing: That element is no longer in the section
fail.empty: Nothing copied — select an element and press Ctrl+C
fail.top: This is the top element in the section

element.name: Name

fields.styleHint: Element style: font, colour and size
fields.imageHint: This is an image — font and text tools do not affect it, so they are hidden.

video.hint: This is a video — pick another one from the library; its place and styling stay as they are.

map.hint: The map is selected for editing; drag it or change its link and size here. Google zoom is off inside the editor.
map.placeholder: Google Maps link, embed code or coordinates
map.help: That link cannot be shown inside a frame. Open the place in Google Maps → Share → "Embed a map" and paste the code, or paste coordinates like: 29.990823, 31.130000

countdown.hint: This is an imported countdown — you can change its date and the order of its boxes, and pick any label from the layers to edit its text or font.

layers.title: Layers
layers.empty: No selectable elements inside the section.

colors.title: Section colours
colors.empty: No colours are written in this section's styles.
colors.hint: Change a colour here and it changes everywhere it is used inside the section.

intro.title: Intro — intro code
intro.hint: Elements of the intro-screen code: click them in the preview (the Intro button replays it) or pick them from the layers.

bounds.label: Section bounds
bounds.hint: Show the frame, then drag the bottom handle to make the section taller or shorter (each device keeps its own height).

overlays.title: Add an element on top of the selected section — drag it anywhere with the mouse
overlays.pick: Select a section first to add this to it.
overlays.unsupported: This section does not accept elements on top of it.
overlays.hint: Drag it anywhere with the mouse; the two handles on its sides change its width. Delete removes it.

layers.title: Layer order
layers.hint: Top to bottom: what's higher covers what's below. Move an element under “Section content” to put it behind the text; select it from here if it gets covered in the preview.
